1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de tronco poco ramificado, hojas pinnadas, flores blancas en racimos terminales y fruto leguminoso con una sola semilla; de su tronco se extrae un aceite que tiene propiedades medicinales. Fabaceae, Copaifera officinalis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 20 m, with a trunk that is poorly branched, pinnate leaves, white flowers in terminal racemes, and leguminous fruit containing a single seed; an oil extracted from its trunk has medicinal properties. Fabaceae, Copaifera officinalis.
